listingTitle: Find one array match without filtering all values
title: Find one array match without filtering all values
why: Array.filter evaluates the full array and allocates a result array even when the caller only consumes the first or last match.
suggestion: Use find for the first match or findLast for the last match when callback short-circuiting preserves the intended behavior.
limitations: Only variables with an array type annotation or array-literal assignment followed by [0], at(0), at(-1), shift(), or pop() are reported.
Sparse-array callback differences, callback side effects, aliases, and custom filter implementations are not inferred.

Loop/function structure and declaration evidence use masked executable source; comment, string and regex literal text does not establish a collection or structural scope. Analysis remains lexical rather than type-resolved.
